Q: docker push error: denied: requested access to the resource is denied A:

So, in case it is helpful to anyone...

I had this same issue and here is what my issue and the FIX was.

  • I had a computer on my test network named 'galaxy'.

  • I setup docker registry using the following run command:

     sudo docker run -d
 --restart=always \
 --name registry \
 -v /srv/registry/certs:/certs \
 -v /srv/registry/storage:/var/lib/registry \
 -e REGISTRY_HTTP_ADDR=0.0.0.0:443 \
 -e REGISTRY_HTTP_TLS_CERTIFICATE=/certs/galaxy.cert \
 -e REGISTRY_HTTP_TLS_KEY=/certs/galaxy.key \
 -p 443:443 \
 registry:2

Then I was trying to push an image to galaxy from a laptop on the network so I did this:

docker login galaxy

This would give me an error that would say:

Login did not succeed, error: Error response from daemon:
    Get https://galaxy/v2/: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

Oddly the fix to this issue was to do a login like this:

docker login galaxy:443

That resulted in a successful login.

So then I tried to push the image from my laptop to 'galaxy'.
I had already created a tag for my image that looked like this:

galaxy/myImage:0.0.1

So I tried to push it doing this:

docker push galaxy/myImage:0.0.1

To which I got the reply:

The push refers to repository [docker.io/galaxy/myImage]
7ab460574f86: Preparing
1aecaf56754d: Preparing
1df1b5f06ca4: Preparing
denied: requested access to the resource is denied

Oddly enough, I discovered the fix for this was to first tag the image as follows:

docker tag myImage:0.0.1 galaxy:443/myImage:0.0.1

... and then do the push like this:

docker push galaxy:443/myImage:0.0.1

So for some reason I had to include the port in the tag as a required part of the repository name.

Q: How do I use FFmpeg to register codecs? A:

Short answer: you can't register a codec standalone (as user).

Long answer: Inspecting avcodec_register_all() found in libavcodec/allcodecs.c we can see how it registers the codecs, hardware accelerators and others.

For example if we would want to register a decoder which has CODEC_ID_H264 we should call avcodec_register(&ff_h264_decoder). The problem is that the ff_h264_decoder is defined only in libavcodec/h264.c but not in any header files thus we can not refer to it.

Then who should use avcodec_register? Users can not, developers should. It is the way of registering a custom avcodec. Good thing is calling avcodec_register_all() more times does not cause problemas, as it registers everything only once.

Q: What is the minimum date time value that can be entered in MySQL column of timestamp datatype? A:

The above answer is correct - your time zone may be causing issues.

The minimum Unix timestamp value will be later than 1970-01-01 00:00:00 in approx half of the world's timezones.

Do "SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(1)" to see your MySQL's minimum value of a timestamp field.

But to make your code more portable, rather than finding out the minimum value by querying FROM_UNXITIME(), why not use that in your query? eg:

UPDATE mytable SET timestamp_field=FROM_UNIXTIME(1) WHERE conditions;

K.

Q: extracting particular numbers from a column of characters based on a criterion A:

tidyr::separate_* is useful here. We can ask to separate the ...1 column where we encounter : , into new columns Year and Month, aligning to the right where only one of the values is provided, then fill down and remove blanks:

df |>
  separate_wider_delim('...1', delim = " :  ", 
                       names = c("Year", "Month"), too_few = "align_end") |>
  fill(Year) |>
  drop_na()

resulting in

# A tibble: 361 × 2
   Year  Month
   <chr> <chr>
 1 1996  1    
 2 1996  2    
 3 1996  3    
 4 1996  4    
 5 1996  5    
 6 1996  6    
 7 1996  7    
 8 1996  8    
 9 1996  9    
10 1996  10   
# ℹ 351 more rows

Q: How can I prevent ClickJacking Attacks using X-Frame-Options Headers A: 

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
</IfModule>

You can get the more details of X-Frame-Options on below https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/X-Frame-Options

You can add below snippet code on last of your server .htaccess file and test the site on https://clickjacker.io/test.
